title: 橋梁頂推施工~Incremental bridge launching
focus: 以導梁、中心預力、滑移支承與高程控制，讓整條連續梁從橋台後方一段段推過每一座橋墩~Launching nose, centric prestress, sliding bearings and level control that let a continuous girder be pushed segment by segment over every pier from behind the abutment
summary: 從頂推過程中每一斷面輪流經過墩頂與跨中所產生的交變彎矩出發，計算導梁長度與中心預力需求，再處理導梁上墩、滑移支承與側向導向、橋台後預製台座的每週循環、臨時墩與鋼橋面頂推，最後以支承反力、頂推力與摩擦監測驗證並完成永久支承安裝與交接，案例涵蓋 Caroní 橋、Kufstein 茵河橋、Ravensbosch 高架橋與 Millau 高架橋。~Starting from the alternating moments that arise as every section passes alternately over piers and midspans, compute launching-nose length and centric prestress, then handle nose landing, sliding bearings and lateral guides, the weekly cycle of the casting bed behind the abutment, temporary piers and steel-deck launching, and finally verify with support reactions, launch force and friction monitoring before installing permanent bearings and handing over, with the Caroní, Kufstein Inn, Ravensbosch and Millau bridges as cases.

units.anchor: 導梁前端懸臂彎矩~Front cantilever moment with nose
units.title: 交變彎矩與導梁的作用~Alternating moments and the role of the nose
units.mechanism: 頂推時整條梁在橋墩上滑動，每一個斷面都會輪流經過墩頂（負彎矩）與跨中（正彎矩），所以斷面必須同時承受兩種符號的彎矩，這與一般連續梁每個斷面只承受固定符號的彎矩完全不同。最嚴重的狀態出現在梁前端剛要到達下一座墩之前：前端成為長懸臂，根部負彎矩隨懸臂長度平方增長。輕質鋼導梁接在梁前端，先一步搭上下一座墩，用很輕的重量取代一大段混凝土懸臂，大幅降低這個峰值。~During launching the whole girder slides over the piers, so every section passes alternately over a pier (hogging) and through midspan (sagging) and must resist both signs of moment, unlike an ordinary continuous girder whose sections see one sign. The worst state occurs just before the front reaches the next pier: the front becomes a long cantilever whose root hogging moment grows with the square of its length. A light steel launching nose attached to the front reaches the next pier first, replacing a long concrete cantilever with a light structure and sharply reducing this peak.
units.model: 跨度 L = 50 m、梁重 w = 200 kN/m、導梁 15 kN/m。無導梁時懸臂彎矩 wL²/2 = 250,000 kN·m；導梁長 0.62L = 31 m 時，混凝土懸臂 19 m：M = 200×19²/2 + 15×31×(19 + 15.5) ≈ 52,143 kN·m，約為無導梁時的 21%，與連續梁墩頂彎矩 wL²/12 ≈ 41,667 kN·m 同一量級。數值為教學假設。~Span L = 50 m, girder w = 200 kN/m, nose 15 kN/m. Without a nose the cantilever moment is wL²/2 = 250,000 kN·m; with a nose 0.62L = 31 m long the concrete cantilever is 19 m: M = 200×19²/2 + 15×31×(19 + 15.5) ≈ 52,143 kN·m, about 21% of the no-nose value and of the same order as the continuous-beam support moment wL²/12 ≈ 41,667 kN·m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以頂推階段分析逐步移動梁位（例如每 1 至 2 m 一個位置），輸出每一斷面在全部位置下的最大正負彎矩包絡線，與手算的懸臂峰值和 wL²/12 比較；包絡線須涵蓋導梁搭墩前後、梁尾離開預製台座等關鍵位置。~Run a launching analysis that moves the girder in steps of, say, 1 to 2 m, output the envelope of maximum positive and negative moments at every section over all positions, and compare it with the hand-calculated cantilever peak and wL²/12; the envelope must include key positions such as just before and after the nose lands and the tail leaving the casting bed.
units.failure: 若只檢核完工連續梁的彎矩分布，忽略頂推時每個斷面都會經過墩頂，跨中斷面可能在頂推中承受設計從未考慮的負彎矩，頂板出現橫向裂縫，甚至在導梁搭墩前因懸臂過長而開裂。~Checking only the finished continuous-girder moments, and forgetting that every section passes over a pier during launching, can impose hogging moments on midspan sections that the design never considered, cracking the top slab transversely, or crack the girder when the cantilever grows too long before the nose lands.
units.misconception: 頂推梁完工後是連續梁，所以只要依連續梁的彎矩分布配置預力即可。~A launched girder ends up continuous, so prestress can simply follow the continuous-beam moment diagram.
units.practice: 設計文件應附頂推階段彎矩與剪力包絡線、導梁長度與重量假設、每座墩的最大反力，並規定承包商改變導梁或跨配置時必須重新分析並經設計單位同意。~Design documents should attach the launching moment and shear envelopes, the assumed nose length and weight and the maximum reaction at every pier, and require re-analysis and designer approval if the contractor changes the nose or span arrangement.

units.title: 中心預力與頂推階段的應力控制~Centric prestress and stress control during launching
units.mechanism: 既然每一個斷面都要承受正負兩種彎矩，頂推階段的預力必須放在斷面形心附近，使頂板與底板同時獲得均勻壓應力，稱為中心預力或頂推預力，通常以頂板與底板的直線鋼腱達成。頂推完成、結構成為連續梁後，再張拉沿彎矩分布配置的連續鋼腱（常為體外鋼腱），補足營運需求。因為中心預力在營運時效率較低，設計者會用較小的跨深比、導梁與臨時墩來降低頂推彎矩，從而減少中心預力用量。~Since every section must resist both positive and negative moment, launching prestress is placed near the centroid so the top and bottom slabs both receive uniform compression, called centric or launching prestress and usually provided by straight tendons in the top and bottom slabs. After launching, once the structure is continuous, continuity tendons following the moment diagram, often external, are stressed to meet service demands. Because centric prestress is less efficient in service, designers reduce launching moments with modest span-to-depth ratios, a nose and temporary piers, minimising the centric prestress needed.
units.model: 頂推負彎矩峰值 52,143 kN·m，斷面模數 S = 10.0 m³、面積 A = 7.0 m²、容許拉應力 1.5 MPa：所需均勻壓應力 σ = 52,143/10.0 − 1,500 ≈ 3,714 kPa，P = 3,714×7.0 ≈ 26,000 kN；以每束 12 股 15.2 mm 有效力約 1,875 kN 計，需 26,000/1,875 ≈ 13.9，取 14 束。數值為教學假設。~With a launching hogging peak of 52,143 kN·m, section modulus S = 10.0 m³, area A = 7.0 m² and 1.5 MPa allowable tension, the required uniform compression is σ = 52,143/10.0 − 1,500 ≈ 3,714 kPa, so P = 3,714×7.0 ≈ 26,000 kN; at about 1,875 kN effective per 12-strand 15.2 mm tendon, 26,000/1,875 ≈ 13.9, so use 14 tendons. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 核對每一段張拉後的中心預力與頂推包絡線所需值，並以施工階段模型確認在所有梁位下頂底板拉應力都在容許範圍；頂推鋼腱多以聯結器逐段接續，須檢查聯結器所在斷面不集中在同一位置，並確認聯結器處的應力與裂縫控制。~Check the centric prestress after each segment is stressed against the envelope demand, and confirm in the staged model that top and bottom tensile stresses stay within limits at every girder position; launching tendons are usually extended segment by segment with couplers, so check that coupler sections are staggered and verify stress and crack control there.
units.failure: 聯結器集中在同一個施工縫斷面時，該處有效預力與鋼筋都較弱，頂推中經過墩頂與跨中反覆受彎，常在施工縫出現貫穿裂縫；中心預力不足則讓底板在跨中位置開裂，日後滲水造成鋼腱腐蝕。~Couplers concentrated at one construction-joint section leave it weaker in effective prestress and reinforcement, and repeated bending over piers and midspans during launching often cracks it through; insufficient centric prestress cracks the bottom slab at midspan positions, later admitting water that corrodes tendons.
units.misconception: 頂推時的預力只要依完工後跨中正彎矩配置在底板即可。~Launching prestress need only be placed in the bottom slab for the final midspan sagging moment.
units.practice: 施工計畫應以表格列出每一段的頂推鋼腱、聯結器位置與張拉時機，並規定在張拉完成並確認伸長量之前不得頂推；頂推後的連續鋼腱張拉順序也須經設計單位核定。~The construction plan should tabulate launching tendons, coupler locations and stressing times for every segment and forbid launching until stressing is complete and elongations are accepted; the post-launch continuity stressing order must also be approved by the designer.

units.anchor: 導梁前端撓度~Nose tip deflection
units.title: 鋼導梁設計與上墩~Steel nose design and landing on the pier
units.mechanism: 導梁通常是兩片鋼板梁或桁架，長度約為跨度的 60% 至 65%，每公尺重量只有混凝土梁的一小部分。導梁本身要夠輕才能降低懸臂彎矩，又要夠勁才能限制前端下垂；到達下一墩時，前端已因混凝土懸臂轉角與導梁自身撓度而低於墩頂，必須靠前端的上墩千斤頂或斜坡把導梁抬上滑板。導梁與混凝土梁的連接處承受很大的彎矩與剪力，是需要特別細部設計與疲勞檢查的節點。~A launching nose is usually two steel plate girders or a truss, about 60% to 65% of the span long and weighing a small fraction of the concrete girder per metre. It must be light enough to reduce the cantilever moment yet stiff enough to limit tip sag; on arrival at the next pier its tip lies below the pier top because of the concrete cantilever's rotation and the nose's own deflection, so a tip jack or ramp must lift it onto the sliding pad. The nose-to-girder connection carries large moment and shear and needs special detailing and fatigue checks.
units.model: 混凝土懸臂 19 m（EI = 35,000 MPa × 8 m⁴）承受自重與導梁 465 kN：端點下撓約 20 mm、轉角約 0.0016 rad，乘導梁長 31 m 得 50 mm；導梁自重 15 kN/m、EI = 210,000 MPa × 0.08 m⁴，自身下撓 15×31⁴/(8EI) ≈ 103 mm，前端合計約 173 mm，上墩千斤頂行程須大於此值。數值為教學假設。~The 19 m concrete cantilever (EI = 35,000 MPa × 8 m⁴) under its own weight and the 465 kN nose deflects about 20 mm at its end with a rotation of about 0.0016 rad, which over the 31 m nose gives 50 mm; the nose itself (15 kN/m, EI = 210,000 MPa × 0.08 m⁴) sags 15×31⁴/(8EI) ≈ 103 mm, so the tip is about 173 mm low and the landing jack stroke must exceed this. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 導梁製作後檢查焊道（非破壞檢測）與栓接預拉力，組裝時量測導梁與混凝土梁的接合角度；首次上墩前預測前端下垂量，現場量測實際值並比較，偏差過大時檢查導梁連接是否鬆動或梁體勁度與假設不同。~After fabrication, inspect nose welds by non-destructive testing and check bolt pretension, and measure the joint angle between nose and concrete girder at assembly; before the first landing, predict the tip sag, measure the actual value and compare, investigating connection slack or girder stiffness differing from assumptions if the deviation is large.
units.failure: 導梁與梁體的連接栓在反覆頂推中鬆動或疲勞開裂，前端下垂逐次加大，最終導梁撞上墩頂或滑板邊緣；若上墩千斤頂行程不足而強行頂推，導梁下翼板可能被墩頂撞擊而局部挫屈。~Bolts joining the nose to the girder can loosen or crack by fatigue under repeated launches so the tip sags more each time until it strikes the pier top or pad edge; launching on with an insufficient landing-jack stroke can let the pier top hit and locally buckle the nose bottom flange.
units.misconception: 導梁越長越好，長度可以等於整個跨度。~The longer the nose the better; it can be as long as the whole span.
units.practice: 導梁在每次頂推前檢查連接栓、焊道與前端千斤頂，每完成若干跨做一次詳細檢查並記錄前端下垂量趨勢；導梁拆除與再利用須經原設計者確認其疲勞紀錄。~Inspect nose bolts, welds and the tip jack before every launch, carry out a detailed inspection every few spans and log the tip-sag trend; dismantling and reuse of a nose requires the original designer to review its fatigue record.

units.anchor: 滑板與側向導向~Sliding pads and lateral guides
units.title: 滑移支承、摩擦與側向導向~Sliding bearings, friction and lateral guidance
units.mechanism: 頂推時梁體底板在每座墩頂的臨時滑移支承上滑動：常見作法是不鏽鋼面的混凝土塊或鋼座，上面不斷插入以橡膠加勁的聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）滑板，滑板隨梁前進，從另一端取出再回送。摩擦力隨溫度、接觸壓力與初始靜摩擦變化，啟動時最大。墩頂兩側還要設側向導向裝置，控制梁體平面位置，曲線橋上導向力更大。梁在縱坡下坡方向頂推時，若摩擦低於坡度分力，梁會自行滑動，必須設制動或拉回裝置。~During launching the girder soffit slides over temporary sliding bearings on each pier: commonly concrete blocks or steel seats faced with stainless steel, onto which elastomer-backed PTFE pads are continuously fed so that they travel with the girder and are retrieved at the far end and returned. Friction varies with temperature, contact pressure and initial static breakaway, peaking at start-up. Lateral guides on both sides of each pier control plan position, with larger guide forces on curved bridges. When launching downhill on a gradient, if friction falls below the slope component the girder can run away by itself, so braking or hold-back devices are required.
units.model: 梁重 W = 200 kN/m × 400 m = 80,000 kN。上坡 2%、摩擦 μ = 0.04：頂推力 F = W(μ + i) = 80,000×0.06 = 4,800 kN。下坡 2% 且摩擦最低只有 0.01 時，下滑淨力 W(i − μ) = 80,000×0.01 = 800 kN，必須由制動裝置抵抗。數值為教學假設。~Girder weight W = 200 kN/m × 400 m = 80,000 kN. Uphill at 2% with μ = 0.04, launch force F = W(μ + i) = 80,000×0.06 = 4,800 kN. Downhill at 2% with a minimum friction of only 0.01, the net runaway force W(i − μ) = 80,000×0.01 = 800 kN must be held by braking devices. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 滑移支承與 PTFE 滑板依規格檢驗材料與表面粗糙度，安裝時量測各墩滑移面高程與橫坡；頂推中記錄每次啟動與等速段的頂推力，反算摩擦係數，並確認側向導向的間隙與受力在設計範圍內。~Check sliding-bearing materials and surface finish against the specification and survey the level and cross-fall of each sliding surface at installation; during launching record the force at breakaway and in steady motion to back-calculate friction, and confirm lateral-guide clearances and forces stay within design limits.
units.failure: 滑板漏放或錯位時，混凝土直接在不鏽鋼面上摩擦，頂推力突增並刮傷底板；側向導向間隙過大，曲線梁逐漸偏離設計位置，最後在支承安裝時找不到正確位置。下坡頂推若未設制動，梁體在千斤頂釋放瞬間可能自行滑移。~A missed or displaced pad lets concrete rub on stainless steel, so launch force jumps and the soffit is scored; excessive lateral-guide clearance lets a curved girder drift from its design position until bearings cannot be set correctly. Downhill launching without braking can let the girder slide on its own when the jacks release.
units.misconception: PTFE 滑板摩擦極低，所以頂推時不必考慮梁體自行滑動。~PTFE pads have such low friction that runaway of the girder need not be considered.
units.practice: 每座墩頂指派專人負責滑板插放與觀察，並以對講系統與頂推控制室連線，任何異常可立即停機；下坡頂推的制動與拉回系統須經設計並在首次頂推前試運轉。~Assign a person at every pier to feed pads and observe, linked by intercom to the launch control room so any anomaly stops the push immediately; braking and hold-back systems for downhill launching must be designed and test-run before the first launch.

units.anchor: 橋台後預製台座~Casting bed behind the abutment
units.title: 預製台座與每週頂推循環~Casting bed and the weekly launching cycle
units.mechanism: 頂推工法把整座橋的製造集中在橋台後方的固定預製台座：每一段約 15 至 25 m，在同一副模板中澆製並緊貼前一段匹配，張拉中心預力後整條梁向前推一段距離，空出台座再做下一段。這讓施工像工廠一樣重複，常見節奏是每週一段。台座本身的基礎與模板精度極重要：每一段都由同一副模板決定幾何，微小的角度誤差會隨每一段傳到整座橋；VSL 的報告指出，若 19 m 的一段誤差 1 mm，累積到全橋可達約 100 mm。~Incremental launching concentrates the manufacture of the whole bridge on a fixed casting bed behind the abutment: each segment, about 15 to 25 m long, is cast in the same formwork against the previous one, centric prestress is stressed, the whole girder is pushed forward by one segment length, and the bed is freed for the next. Work repeats like a factory, typically at one segment per week. The bed's foundation and form accuracy are critical because one formwork sets the geometry of every segment and small angular errors propagate through the bridge; a VSL report notes that a 1 mm error over one 19 m segment could accumulate to about 100 mm over the bridge length.
units.model: 橋長 420 m、每段 19 m：420/19 ≈ 22.1，取 23 段，每週一段約 23 × 7 = 161 天。頂推速度 3 至 6 m/h 時，一段 19 m 純移動時間約 19/6 ≈ 3.2 h 至 19/3 ≈ 6.3 h，頂推本身只占循環很小部分，關鍵是鋼筋、澆置、養護與張拉。數值為教學假設。~For a 420 m bridge in 19 m segments, 420/19 ≈ 22.1, so 23 segments; at one per week that is about 23 × 7 = 161 days. At launching speeds of 3 to 6 m/h, moving one 19 m segment takes about 19/6 ≈ 3.2 h to 19/3 ≈ 6.3 h, a small part of the cycle; reinforcement, casting, curing and stressing are critical. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 預製台座基礎在使用前做沉陷觀測並定期複測，底模與側模在每一段澆置前以精密水準量測高程與線形（目標精度為十分之一公釐級）；每段完成後量測端面位置與梁底高程，與理論縱斷面比較並回饋下一段。~Monitor settlement of the casting-bed foundation before use and re-survey periodically; before every cast, level the soffit and side forms precisely, aiming at tenth-of-a-millimetre accuracy; after each segment, survey the end face position and soffit level, compare with the theoretical profile and feed back to the next segment.
units.failure: 台座基礎不均勻沉陷而未察覺，每一段的底模都帶著相同的微小傾角，梁底成為鋸齒或折線，到了遠端墩頂高差可達數公分，頂推中支承反力重新分配，梁體出現非預期裂縫。~Unnoticed differential settlement of the casting bed gives every segment the same small tilt, so the soffit becomes a saw-tooth or kinked line; at distant piers level errors reach several centimetres, reactions redistribute during launching and unexpected cracks appear.
units.misconception: 頂推梁在台座上製作，幾何誤差可以在頂推後再一次修正。~Because the girder is cast on a bed, geometric errors can be corrected after launching.
units.practice: 預製台座的基礎、底模支撐與量測控制點應有專屬設計與檢查表，每段澆置前的模板高程單由測量工程師簽認；台座附近禁止堆放重物或開挖，避免改變基礎狀態。~The casting bed's foundation, soffit supports and survey control need their own design and checklist, with a form-level sheet signed by the survey engineer before every cast; heavy stockpiles and excavation near the bed are forbidden to avoid disturbing its foundation.

units.anchor: 臨時墩與多點頂推~Temporary piers and multi-point launching
units.title: 臨時墩、鋼橋面與分散式頂推~Temporary piers, steel decks and distributed launching
units.mechanism: 當永久跨度超過頂推經濟範圍時，可在跨中設臨時墩，把頂推跨度減半。Millau 高架橋的鋼橋面由谷地兩側分別頂推，以臨時支撐把 342 m 主跨分成約 171 m 的頂推跨，最高臨時支撐約 175 m。頂推長而重的梁時，若只在橋台集中施力，各墩頂的摩擦力都會以水平力推動高墩；改在每座墩與臨時墩頂設同步控制的頂推裝置，各點只克服本身摩擦，墩頂水平力大幅降低。鋼橋面頂推還要檢查腹板在滑移點的局部承壓與挫屈。~When permanent spans exceed the economic launching range, temporary piers at midspan halve the launch span. Millau's steel deck was launched from both sides of the valley with temporary supports dividing the 342 m spans into launch spans of about 171 m, the tallest temporary support being about 175 m high. Pushing a long heavy girder from the abutment alone makes the friction at every pier push the tall piers horizontally; synchronised launching devices on each pier and temporary support let each point overcome only its own friction, sharply reducing horizontal pier forces. Steel decks also need checks of web patch loading and buckling at the sliding points.
units.model: 某臨時墩反力 R = 25,000 kN、摩擦 μ = 0.05：若由橋台集中頂推，該墩頂水平力 H = 0.05×25,000 = 1,250 kN，在 175 m 高處造成墩底彎矩 1,250×175 ≈ 218,750 kN·m；若墩頂自設頂推裝置，H 接近零。半橋頂推 1,000 m、每循環 0.6 m 約需 1,667 循環，每循環 4 分鐘則純移動約 111 h。數值為教學假設。~For a temporary pier reaction R = 25,000 kN and μ = 0.05, launching from the abutment alone puts H = 0.05×25,000 = 1,250 kN on the pier top, a base moment of 1,250×175 ≈ 218,750 kN·m at 175 m height; with its own launching device on the pier top, H is close to zero. Launching half a deck 1,000 m at 0.6 m per cycle needs about 1,667 cycles, about 111 h of movement at 4 minutes per cycle. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 臨時墩設計須檢核頂推中最不利的垂直反力、水平力與風載組合，並量測臨時墩頂的位移與傾斜；分散式頂推以中央電腦同步控制，記錄每一點的推力與行程，任何一點推力偏離設定範圍即自動停機。~Temporary-pier design must cover the worst launching combination of vertical reaction, horizontal force and wind, with displacement and tilt monitored at the pier top; distributed launching is synchronised by a central computer that logs each point's force and stroke and stops automatically if any point leaves its set range.
units.failure: 分散式頂推不同步時，某一墩的裝置推得比其他快，該墩頂承受反向水平力，高墩或臨時墩可能過度變形；鋼橋面腹板在滑移點若未加勁，局部承壓可使腹板挫屈，頂推被迫中斷補強。~If distributed devices lose synchronisation, one pushes faster than the rest and its pier takes a reverse horizontal force that can over-deflect a tall or temporary pier; an unstiffened steel web at a sliding point can buckle under patch loading, halting the launch for strengthening.
units.misconception: 臨時墩只承受垂直力，不需要考慮水平力。~Temporary piers carry only vertical force, so horizontal force can be ignored.
units.practice: 頂推作業前召開停留點會議，確認臨時墩與高墩的位移監測、風速限制、同步系統測試與緊急停機程序；每次頂推由頂推總指揮統一下令，各墩回報就緒後才能啟動。~Hold a hold-point meeting before launching to confirm displacement monitoring of temporary and tall piers, wind limits, synchronisation tests and emergency stops; every push is ordered by a single launch director and starts only after every pier reports ready.

units.anchor: 墩頂高程偏差與反力~Pier level deviation and reactions
units.title: 支承高程偏差與反力量測~Support level deviations and reaction measurement
units.mechanism: 頂推中的梁是一根很長的連續梁，墩頂滑移面高程只要偏差幾公釐，就會改變各墩反力與梁內彎矩，這也是歐洲規範要求頂推分析必須考慮支承高程偏差的原因。因此在每座墩頂滑移支承下設置油壓千斤頂或荷重計，頂推過程中直接量測反力，比較預測值；若某一墩反力明顯偏高，可能是滑移面過高、梁底局部凸起或台座幾何誤差，須在下一次頂推前調整。~A girder being launched is a long continuous beam, and a deviation of a few millimetres in a pier's sliding-surface level changes every reaction and the internal moments, which is why European rules require launching analyses to include support level deviations. Hydraulic jacks or load cells under each pier's sliding bearing therefore measure reactions directly during launching for comparison with predictions; a reaction well above prediction may mean a sliding surface set too high, a local bulge on the soffit or casting-bed geometry error, to be adjusted before the next push.
units.model: 兩等跨連續梁中間支承下陷 δ 時，反力變化 ΔR = 6EI·δ/L³。EI = 2.8×10⁸ kN·m²、L = 50 m、δ = 10 mm：ΔR = 6×2.8×10⁸×0.01/50³ ≈ 134 kN，墩頂附加彎矩 ΔM = ΔR·L/2 ≈ 3,360 kN·m，約為 wL²/12 的 8%。數值為教學假設。~For a two-equal-span continuous beam whose middle support drops δ, the reaction changes by ΔR = 6EI·δ/L³. With EI = 2.8×10⁸ kN·m², L = 50 m and δ = 10 mm, ΔR = 6×2.8×10⁸×0.01/50³ ≈ 134 kN and the added support moment ΔM = ΔR·L/2 ≈ 3,360 kN·m, about 8% of wL²/12. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每座墩的滑移面在安裝後與每次頂推前以精密水準複測，偏差超過設計容許值即以墊片調整；反力量測系統須先校正，頂推中以固定梁位（例如每段頂推完成時）記錄全部反力，總和應等於已頂出梁重，並與預測分布比較。~Re-level each sliding surface precisely after installation and before every push, shimming if the deviation exceeds the design allowance; calibrate the reaction-measurement system first, record all reactions at fixed girder positions such as the end of each push, check that their sum equals the launched weight, and compare the distribution with prediction.
units.failure: 若某座墩滑移面偏高而未調整，該墩反力持續偏大，梁經過時底板局部承壓過高、腹板出現斜裂縫；相鄰墩反力不足則讓滑板滑出或側向導向失效。~A sliding surface left too high keeps that pier's reaction above prediction, overstressing the soffit locally and cracking webs diagonally as the girder passes; neighbouring piers with too little reaction may let pads slide out or lateral guides lose effect.
units.misconception: 墩頂高程差幾公釐對頂推中的長梁沒有影響。~A few millimetres of pier-level difference has no effect on a long girder being launched.
units.practice: 頂推紀錄表應包含每座墩的滑移面高程、反力讀值、溫度與梁位，與預測值的偏差由設計單位設定警戒與停止門檻；所有原始量測資料保存至竣工。~The launching log should include each pier's sliding-surface level, reaction readings, temperature and girder position, with alert and stop thresholds for deviations set by the designer; all raw measurements are kept until completion.

units.title: 頂推力、摩擦反算與變形監測~Launch force, back-calculated friction and deformation monitoring
units.mechanism: 頂推力是頂推過程中最直接的健康指標：它等於所有墩頂摩擦力與坡度分力的總和，若突然增加，代表某處滑板漏放、側向導向卡住或梁底有障礙；若緩慢下降，可能是溫度升高使摩擦降低。把每一次頂推的啟動力與等速力記錄下來，就能反算實際摩擦係數，與設計假設比較。同時以全站儀追蹤導梁前端與梁體平面位置，以應變計觀察關鍵斷面，確認結構行為與分析一致。~Launch force is the most direct health indicator during launching: it equals the sum of all pier friction forces and the gradient component, so a sudden rise signals a missing pad, a jammed lateral guide or an obstruction under the soffit, while a slow fall may reflect warmer weather lowering friction. Logging breakaway and steady-motion forces for every push lets engineers back-calculate the real friction coefficient and compare it with design. Meanwhile a total station tracks the nose tip and the girder's plan position, and strain gauges at key sections confirm the structure behaves as analysed.
units.model: 摩擦反算 μ = F/W − i。某次等速頂推力 F = 3,600 kN、已頂出梁重 W = 60,000 kN、上坡 i = 1%：μ = 3,600/60,000 − 0.01 = 0.05（5%）。若設計假設 μ_max = 4%，表示需要檢查滑板或導向，並重新評估千斤頂容量餘裕。數值為教學假設。~Back-calculated friction μ = F/W − i. A steady launch force F = 3,600 kN for a launched weight W = 60,000 kN uphill at i = 1% gives μ = 3,600/60,000 − 0.01 = 0.05 (5%). If the design assumed μ_max = 4%, pads or guides must be checked and the jack capacity margin re-evaluated. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 頂推千斤頂與壓力感測器須校正，控制系統自動記錄推力—行程曲線；每次頂推後繪製摩擦係數隨梁長與溫度的趨勢，與設計上下限比較。VSL 報告記載 Ravensbosch 高架橋初期摩擦偏高，之後穩定在約 5%，與設計假設相符，這正是此類比對的例子。~Calibrate launching jacks and pressure sensors and have the control system log force–stroke curves automatically; after every push plot the friction coefficient against launched length and temperature and compare it with the design bounds. A VSL report records that friction at the Ravensbosch Viaduct was high at first and then settled at about 5%, matching the design assumption, an example of exactly this comparison.
units.failure: 若只看推力是否在千斤頂容量內而不分析趨勢，滑板逐漸損耗或某墩導向逐漸卡緊的徵兆會被忽略，直到推力突然超限而被迫停在半途，此時梁可能停在對結構最不利的位置。~Watching only whether the force stays within jack capacity, without analysing trends, misses gradual pad wear or a guide slowly jamming until the force suddenly exceeds the limit and the push stops halfway, possibly leaving the girder in its most unfavourable position.
units.misconception: 頂推力只與梁重有關，與溫度和滑板狀態無關。~Launch force depends only on girder weight, not on temperature or pad condition.
units.practice: 頂推前由設計單位提供每段頂推的預測推力範圍與停止門檻；中途停止時，必須確認當下梁位是可以長時間停留的安全狀態，否則先完成到下一個安全位置。~Before launching, the designer provides the predicted force range and stop threshold for every push; if a push must stop, confirm that the girder position is safe for a long stay, otherwise first complete it to the next safe position.

units.anchor: 永久支承置換頂升~Jacking onto permanent bearings
units.title: 頂推完成後的支承安裝與預力轉換~Bearing installation and prestress transition after launching
units.mechanism: 梁推到最終位置後，要從臨時滑移支承轉換到永久支承：在每座墩以油壓千斤頂把梁頂起數公釐（VSL 報告記載約 5 至 10 mm），拆除滑移支承，安裝永久支承後再落梁。同時張拉沿彎矩分布的連續鋼腱，必要時拆除或放鬆部分中心預力，使結構轉為營運狀態。頂升過程等同於人為製造支承高程差，所以必須同步、分級並限制相鄰墩的高差，否則會在梁內引起不必要的彎矩。~Once the girder reaches its final position, it must be transferred from temporary sliding bearings to permanent bearings: hydraulic jacks lift it a few millimetres at each pier, about 5 to 10 mm according to a VSL report, the sliding bearings are removed, permanent bearings installed and the girder lowered. Continuity tendons following the moment diagram are stressed and, where needed, part of the centric prestress is removed or released, bringing the structure to its service state. Jacking is effectively an imposed support-level difference, so it must be synchronised, staged and limited in level difference between adjacent piers, or it induces unwanted moments.
units.model: 內墩反力約 R = 1.25wL = 1.25×200×50 = 12,500 kN，頂升 10 mm 另增 ΔR ≈ 134 kN，共約 12,634 kN；以 4 支千斤頂且每支只用到 60% 容量，單支需 12,634/4/0.6 ≈ 5,264 kN，宜選 6,000 kN 級。數值為教學假設。~An interior pier reaction of about R = 1.25wL = 1.25×200×50 = 12,500 kN plus ΔR ≈ 134 kN for a 10 mm lift gives about 12,634 kN; with 4 jacks each used to only 60% of capacity, each needs 12,634/4/0.6 ≈ 5,264 kN, so a 6,000 kN class jack is suitable. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 頂升計畫列出每一墩的頂升量、順序、相鄰墩最大高差與千斤頂壓力預測值；頂升時同步量測位移與壓力，任一值超出預測範圍即停止。永久支承安裝後確認方向、預設偏位（考慮溫度與潛變）與墊石砂漿強度，再落梁並記錄最終反力。~The jacking plan lists lift, order, maximum level difference between adjacent piers and predicted jack pressure for each pier; during jacking, displacement and pressure are measured together and work stops if any value leaves the predicted range. After installing permanent bearings, confirm orientation, preset offset for temperature and creep, and grout strength before lowering, then record final reactions.
units.failure: 各墩頂升不同步，造成某墩瞬間承擔過大反力或梁頂板開裂；永久支承預設偏位忘記考慮安裝時溫度，活動支承在夏季或冬季頂到行程末端，對墩柱產生非預期水平力。~Unsynchronised jacking makes one pier momentarily carry an excessive reaction or cracks the top slab; forgetting the installation temperature when presetting bearing offsets drives sliding bearings to the end of travel in summer or winter, imposing unexpected horizontal force on the piers.
units.misconception: 頂推完成就等於施工完成，支承轉換只是簡單的換件作業。~Once launching ends construction is finished; changing to permanent bearings is a simple swap.
units.practice: 支承轉換與連續鋼腱張拉列為設計單位簽認的停留點，頂升紀錄與最終反力隨支承編號存檔；永久支承的預設偏位以安裝當日實測溫度計算並記錄。~Bearing transfer and continuity stressing are hold points signed off by the designer, with jacking records and final reactions filed by bearing number; permanent-bearing preset offsets are calculated and recorded from the measured temperature on the day of installation.

units.anchor: 長連續梁伸縮量~Movement of a long continuous deck
units.title: 長連續梁的伸縮、耐久與交接~Movement, durability and handover of long continuous decks
units.mechanism: 頂推工法造就的是很長、沒有中間伸縮縫的連續梁，溫度、乾縮與潛變造成的長度變化全部集中在梁端，因此梁端伸縮縫與活動支承的行程必須足夠，固定點（常在一側橋台或中間墩）也要能承受制動力與摩擦力。頂推過程中底板曾在每一座墩頂滑過，滑移區可能留下刮痕、局部修補或滑板殘留物，都要在交接前檢查並處理。交接文件則應保存頂推期間的反力、推力、高程與裂縫紀錄，作為日後評估的基準。~Launching produces long continuous girders without intermediate joints, so length changes from temperature, shrinkage and creep all accumulate at the girder ends; end expansion joints and sliding bearings need sufficient travel, and the fixed point, often one abutment or a central pier, must resist braking and bearing friction. During launching the soffit slid over every pier, possibly leaving scoring, local repairs or pad debris that must be inspected and dealt with before handover. Handover documents should keep the reaction, force, level and crack records from launching as the baseline for later assessment.
units.model: 固定於一端的 420 m 連續梁，溫度變化範圍 ΔT = 45°C、α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C：ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×420,000 mm×45 ≈ 189 mm，另加乾縮與潛變的縮短量，梁端伸縮縫與支承行程須以此為基礎再加安裝餘裕。數值為教學假設。~For a 420 m continuous girder fixed at one end with a temperature range ΔT = 45°C and α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C, ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×420,000 mm×45 ≈ 189 mm, plus shrinkage and creep shortening; the end joint and bearing travel are based on this plus an installation margin. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接前檢查底板滑移區、施工縫與聯結器斷面的裂縫並建立裂縫圖，量測各支承的偏位與伸縮縫間隙，並以當日溫度換算回設計參考溫度確認預設值正確；建立梁端位移的長期量測點，追蹤乾縮與潛變造成的縮短趨勢。~Before handover, inspect the soffit sliding zones, construction joints and coupler sections and draw crack maps, measure bearing offsets and joint gaps, and convert them to the design reference temperature using the day's temperature to confirm presets; set long-term measuring points at the girder ends to track shortening from shrinkage and creep.
units.failure: 梁端伸縮縫行程只依溫度計算而忽略多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，數年後伸縮縫在冬季拉開超過設計值，止水帶撕裂、雨水流到支承與墩帽；固定墩若未考慮支承摩擦累積，墩柱可能出現水平裂縫。~Sizing the end joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep shortening, lets it open beyond its design gap in winter after a few years, tearing the seal and draining water onto bearings and pier caps; a fixed pier designed without accumulated bearing friction may crack horizontally.
units.misconception: 頂推梁沒有中間伸縮縫，所以溫度變化的影響比較小。~A launched girder has no intermediate joints, so temperature effects are smaller.
units.practice: 交接資料應包含頂推分析與實測紀錄、預製台座幾何紀錄、支承與伸縮縫的預設與安裝溫度、滑移區修補紀錄，以及梁端位移監測基準；首次定期檢查應確認伸縮縫行程與支承偏位是否符合預測趨勢。~Handover data should include launching analyses and measured records, casting-bed geometry records, bearing and joint presets with installation temperatures, sliding-zone repair records and the girder-end movement baseline; the first routine inspection should confirm that joint travel and bearing offsets follow the predicted trend.

example: 設計比較練習：跨度 L = 50 m、梁重 w = 200 kN/m、導梁 15 kN/m，比較三種導梁長度。導梁 0.5L = 25 m 時，混凝土懸臂 25 m，M = 200×25²/2 + 15×25×(25 + 12.5) ≈ 76,563 kN·m；導梁 0.62L = 31 m 時 M ≈ 52,143 kN·m；導梁 0.7L = 35 m 時懸臂彎矩降為 200×15²/2 + 15×35×(15 + 17.5) ≈ 39,563 kN·m，但此時控制值改為連續梁墩頂彎矩 wL²/12 ≈ 41,667 kN·m。取 S = 10.0 m³、A = 7.0 m²、容許拉應力 1.5 MPa、每束有效力 1,875 kN，所需中心預力分別為：0.5L 時 (76,563/10 − 1,500)×7.0 ≈ 43,094 kN（約 23 束）；0.62L 時約 26,000 kN（14 束）；0.7L 時 (41,667/10 − 1,500)×7.0 ≈ 18,667 kN（10 束）。導梁由 0.5L 加長到 0.62L 可省約 9 束，但再加長到 0.7L 只再省 4 束，且導梁更長更重、上墩撓度更大。這說明導梁長度約取跨度 60% 至 65% 的工程理由。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。~Design comparison: span L = 50 m, girder w = 200 kN/m, nose 15 kN/m, three nose lengths. With a 0.5L = 25 m nose the concrete cantilever is 25 m and M = 200×25²/2 + 15×25×(25 + 12.5) ≈ 76,563 kN·m; with 0.62L = 31 m, M ≈ 52,143 kN·m; with 0.7L = 35 m the cantilever moment drops to 200×15²/2 + 15×35×(15 + 17.5) ≈ 39,563 kN·m, but the continuous-beam support moment wL²/12 ≈ 41,667 kN·m then governs. With S = 10.0 m³, A = 7.0 m², 1.5 MPa allowable tension and 1,875 kN effective per tendon, the centric prestress needed is (76,563/10 − 1,500)×7.0 ≈ 43,094 kN (about 23 tendons) for 0.5L, about 26,000 kN (14 tendons) for 0.62L and (41,667/10 − 1,500)×7.0 ≈ 18,667 kN (10 tendons) for 0.7L. Lengthening the nose from 0.5L to 0.62L saves about 9 tendons, but going on to 0.7L saves only 4 more while the nose gets longer, heavier and sags more at landing. This is the engineering reason for noses of about 60% to 65% of the span. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
history: 德國 Leonhardt 與 Baur 的團隊在 1960 年代初建造委內瑞拉 Caroní 河橋，梁體在橋台後組成後頂推越過橋墩，並在每跨設臨時墩、以鋼桁架延伸前端，被 VSL 報告稱為首次具備此工法主要特徵的工程；1965 年奧地利 Kufstein 茵河橋首度採用在橋台後逐段澆製、匹配後整體頂推的真正頂推工法。1970 年代起滑板、導梁與液壓頂推設備標準化，VSL 1977 年的技術報告整理了 30 至 60 m 的經濟跨度與每週一段的循環，20 世紀全球頂推的預力混凝土橋超過 2,500 座。2001 至 2004 年 Millau 高架橋的鋼橋面由谷地兩側以分散式液壓裝置頂推，配合最高約 175 m 的臨時支撐，把工法推向高墩大跨。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~In the early 1960s Leonhardt and Baur's team built the Caroní River bridge in Venezuela, assembling the deck behind the abutment and launching it over the piers with a temporary pier in each span and a steel truss extension at the front, described in a VSL report as the first use of the method's essential features; in 1965 the Inn bridge at Kufstein, Austria, introduced true incremental launching, casting segments behind the abutment, match-casting each against the last and pushing the whole deck forward. From the 1970s sliding pads, noses and hydraulic launching equipment became standard, a 1977 VSL technical report summarised economic spans of 30 to 60 m and a one-segment-per-week cycle, and more than 2,500 prestressed concrete bridges were launched worldwide in the 20th century. Between 2001 and 2004 Millau's steel deck was launched from both sides of the valley by distributed hydraulic devices with temporary supports up to about 175 m tall, extending the method to tall piers and long spans. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: VSL 1977 報告：頂推工法經濟跨度約 30 至 60 m，端跨不宜超過標準跨的 75%~VSL's 1977 report gives economic spans of about 30 to 60 m, with end spans not exceeding 75% of the standard span
頂推段長約 15 至 25 m，每週一段，頂推速度約 3 至 6 m/h~Launching segments are about 15 to 25 m long, one per week, at launching speeds of about 3 to 6 m/h
導梁長度約為跨度的 60% 至 65%，重約 1 至 2 t/m~Launching noses are about 60% to 65% of the span long and weigh about 1 to 2 t/m
頂推梁跨深比通常 12 至 15，不宜超過 17~Launched girders usually have span-to-depth ratios of 12 to 15 and not more than 17
荷蘭 Ravensbosch 高架橋長 420 m（42 + 6×56 + 42 m），頂推總重約 11,500 t，摩擦穩定在約 5%~The Ravensbosch Viaduct is 420 m long (42 + 6×56 + 42 m), with about 11,500 t launched and friction settling at about 5%
Caroní 河橋梁體約 480 m，跨度約 96 m，每跨設臨時墩~The Caroní River bridge deck was about 480 m long with spans of about 96 m and a temporary pier in each span

Millau 高架橋全長 2,460 m，以約 171 m 的頂推跨由兩側頂推，最高臨時支撐約 175 m~The Millau Viaduct is 2,460 m long and was launched from both sides in launch spans of about 171 m, with the tallest temporary support about 175 m
Millau 最後一次頂推重量約 20,000 t，每循環前進約 600 mm、歷時約 4 分鐘~Millau's final launch moved about 20,000 t, each cycle advancing about 600 mm in about 4 minutes
20 世紀全球以頂推工法建造的預力混凝土橋超過 2,500 座~More than 2,500 prestressed concrete bridges were launched worldwide in the 20th century
